bio.text: James Walkinshaw is serving his first term representing Virginia's 11th Congressional District.
He served on the Fairfax County Board of Supervisors, representing the Braddock District, from 2020 to September 2025, and earlier spent more than a decade as chief of staff to Rep. Gerry Connolly.
Walkinshaw graduated from New York University in 2005 and lives in Fairfax.
